claims.claim: American used lens, clean and pure like new.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G lens, but do not show condition details like scratches/fungus/haze/oil or any functional testing.
Witness report reads “50mm 1/8G” on the lens barrel in Photos 0–2.

risks.risk: Optical condition issues (scratches, fungus, haze, oil, or heavy internal dust) that reduce image quality; photos may not reveal fine defects.
risks.proof: A clear photo of both front and rear elements at an angle against light (and a close-up of the rear element), plus a short video showing the lens glass under flashlight for haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown optical condition (worst-case: possible haze/fungus/oil), not as “like new”.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (front/rear caps and/or hood) affecting usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A photo showing everything included laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood if any, and any box/papers).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming caps/hood may be missing.

risks.risk: Autofocus/aperture may not work correctly (AF-S motor, aperture blades), even if the lens looks fine.
risks.proof: A short test video on a working Nikon body showing autofocus lock and aperture changes (e.g., from wide open to stopped down) with focus confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to function perfectly (worst-case: AF/aperture issues).

risks.risk: Mount condition problems (thread damage, wobble/play, dirty contacts) causing fit or performance issues.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens mount from multiple angles showing contacts/threads, plus a clip showing the lens seated firmly with no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown mount condition (worst-case: some play/fit issues).

risks.risk: Model/version mismatch or mislabeling beyond what’s readable (e.g., different 50mm 1.8G variants).
risks.proof: A photo of the full barrel markings including any additional printed text and the serial number area (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced based on the readable identification only (Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G), with no premium for exact variant certainty.

proof_requests: Confirm the focal length and model with a clear shot of the full barrel text (showing “50mm 1.8G” clearly) and any other markings/serial number area.
Provide clear photos of both front and rear elements (front + rear) under strong light to check for fungus/haze/oil/scratches.
Show what accessories are included (front cap, rear cap, hood, box/papers if any) in one laid-out photo.
Do a quick autofocus + aperture functionality test on a Nikon body (short video showing AF lock and aperture stop-down).
Take close-up photos of the mount/contacts and a clip showing the lens seated with no wobble.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies the lens as Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition; the seller’s “60mm” claim is contradicted by the readable “50mm” markings.
